title: 静态姿势评估
requirements: Accepted sources have a real alpha channel and were visually checked on a neutral background.
Each scene uses one Bojji and one Despa, without readable text, floor, room, cast shadow, duplicate pose or sequence framing.
Overview art is independently generated and compositionally distinct from its corresponding knowledge image.
Static posture observation emphasizes consent, privacy, descriptive language, repeatability, dynamic verification and referral boundaries rather than diagnosis.

accepted.review: A respectful consent-card exchange introduces voluntary, privacy-aware observation without diagnostic imagery.
A compact choice gesture and blank consent card show voluntary participation and limited record use.
A relaxed upright stance and open-handed observation support descriptive relative-position language only.
Two empty card compartments illustrate repeat observations without a photo, score or conclusion.
A controlled shallow squat converts a static clue into a safe dynamic question rather than a correction prescription.
Open hands at a respectful distance communicate neutral feedback and a jointly chosen next step.
Independent consent composition is distinct from the wide knowledge scene.
Independent frontal neutral-stance panel contains no posture markings or diagnosis cue.
Independent two-compartment record-card panel communicates repeated context checks.
Independent dynamic-squat panel keeps the observer calm and non-corrective.
Independent no-prop exchange keeps the feedback and next-step choice neutral.

rejected.reason: Figures were too close to the canvas edge for the required safety margin.
Figures were too close to the canvas edge for the required safety margin.
The compact figures still sat too close to the upper canvas edge.
Bojji was squatting rather than standing in a neutral posture.
A prohibited clipboard/record prop appeared in the feedback scene.
